rows.definition: `gate_lower_bound` is the scalar floor of the linear-attention decay gate: the GGUF key `<arch>.kda.gate_lower_bound` (Kimi K3.1 ships -5.0) is read at `internal/ggufload/kimik31.go:269` into `model.Config.LinearGateLowerBound` (`internal/model/config.go:288`), and the same conceptual axis appears nested as GLM-5.3-Flash `linear_attn_config.gate_lower_bound` (`internal/model/config.go:506`, propagated at `:586`). This row positions that wire-level config axis.
rows.distinction: Use `gate_lower_bound` for the decay-gate floor value carried in a GGUF header or a linear-attention config block. Unlike `GatedDeltaNet` (the linear-attention SSM layer family, row guardgate-gateddeltanet), it is a scalar knob inside such a layer, not the layer family; unlike `guard-gate`, it is not the umbrella domain.
